parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` — `iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession` in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` and `EntityResolverMockWebSession` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift`. Although they share the `requestedURLs:[URL]` field and a broadly similar shape, the `responses` field differs meaningfully (`[Data]` vs `[String: Data]`), reflecting genuinely different stubbing contracts for their respective test subjects. Extracting a generic shared mock into production or shared-test infrastructure would couple two unrelated test packages (Artwork and Metadata) and obscure the intent of each fixture. The structural overlap is coincidental within the test-fixture context, and the decision rules direct a no-action recommendation when all records are test-only.
